meta.source: BLS QCEW 2023 NAICS 326 private metro average weekly wage; BEA Regional Price Parities 2023 (MARPP, all items)
meta.row: One row is one metro: its nominal average weekly wage, its price level, and that wage restated in national-average purchasing power.
meta.geography: Metro, not county: this page never uses the PIC-12 county footprint. Price parities are published for metropolitan areas only and cannot be summed to a county footprint.
meta.not: Not a cost-of-living ranking and not a quality-of-life claim. The price level compares one fixed national basket across metros; it says nothing about the jobs, schools or airports.
meta.suppression: Metros where QCEW withholds NAICS 326 wages are absent, not zero. Every rank is among the disclosed.
